* '''Original''' ([[Toryn Farr (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-torynfarr022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/torynfarr.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/torynfarr.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
